verdict.rationale: SAM.gov exposes a broad set of read/search APIs: entity data with rich filtering and tiered access, plus opportunities, exclusions, contracts, federal hierarchy and assistance listings. Entity Management also publishes an OpenAPI spec. However, the evidence shows only data-retrieval endpoints, while UI capabilities such as entity registration and wage-determination lookup have no documented API. Getting an API key and approving a system account also both require UI steps. Missing for 10: API equivalents for entity registration and other write/transactional UI workflows, a wage determinations API, programmatic key/account provisioning, and the 1,000,000-record result cap lifted or worked around.
